name: lfm2-1.2b-koen-mt-v4-100k
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from LiquidAI/LFM2-1.2B (config.json max_position_embeddings 128000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-02. A finetune of LiquidAI/LFM2-1.2B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.17 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other, repo created 2025-12-13. CAVEAT: one benchmark family (Flores-200 en-ko devtest, greedy decode, no prompt template printed) on 100k rows of parallel data the authors selected; no ko-en direction is broken out separately in the table this row comes from, though the model-index tag claims both. A sibling already in the catalog, lfm2-1-2b-koen-mt-v8-rl-10k-merged, scores higher on the same benchmark family (CHrF++ 34.61 vs 31.53), so this checkpoint is NOT the best Korean MT model in this family - it is the one whose card prints a base column. FLOPs per active token set to 2.34e+09 (= 2 * active_params_b * 1e9, SCHEMA.md:543) rather than the generator's 6e9 coefficient, which is a 3x overstatement still live in tools/mk_finetune_record.py:251; value overwritten from base record lfm2-1-2b.
